title: Autonomous Astra GOLD mission
description: Operate Astra autonomously through the complete qualification queue without manual Continue prompts. Observe, reconcile, select, execute, verify, and record each dependency. Establish worker/runtime state and reconcile to target SHA, then execute backend qualification, fresh pre-soak evidence, strict verifier, distributed verification, and canonical GOLD executor when all admission gates pass. On a failed gate, diagnose and implement an in-scope repository fix when possible, commit it, self-sync, and continue with a fresh evidence cycle. Never fabricate PASS, bypass provider/auth/quota/region/fencing/recovery controls, expose secrets, or create duplicate GOLD runs. Preserve canonical node mh-dev-01 and GitHub transport. Continue until Astra GOLD is actually qualified or an objectively non-remediable external blocker remains; record every state transition and final evidence. Existing completed 24h run is historical baseline and must not be duplicated. Mission implementation is pinned to this target revision; continue only on an ancestor-compatible current main.
